description: This source file implements module management functions for the lighttpd web server, including creating, loading, releasing, and locating modules. It manages shared libraries (modules) dynamically loaded at runtime, with functions for initialization and cleanup.

classes.name: liModules
classes.description: Structure representing a collection of modules, including management metadata like version, main context, list of modules, and directory path.

classes.name: liModule
classes.description: Structure representing an individual loadable module, including name, path, reference count, and function pointers for initialization and cleanup.

methods.name: liModules * li_modules_new(gpointer main,const gchar * module_dir,gboolean module_resident)
methods.description: Creates a new liModules object with specified main context, module directory, and residency flag.

methods.name: liModule * li_module_lookup(liModules * mods,const gchar * name)
methods.description: Searches for a loaded module by name within the provided modules structure.

methods.name: void li_modules_free(liModules * mods)
methods.description: Releases all modules associated with the provided modules structure and frees associated resources.

methods.name: liModule * li_module_load(liModules * mods,const gchar * name,GError ** err)
methods.description: Loads a module by name, dynamically opening the shared library, calling its init function, and managing references.

methods.name: void li_module_release(liModules * mods,liModule * mod)
methods.description: Decrements reference count of a module and releases it if no longer in use, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: void li_module_release_name(liModules * mods,const gchar * name)
methods.description: Releases a module by name, locating it and decreasing its reference count.
